_comment: IMPORTANT: This list is intentionally empty. Populate it with professionally-sourced crisis terms from published screening tools (e.g., Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale, SAMHSA guidelines, DSM-5 criteria). DO NOT invent terms yourself. Consult mental health literature, published RAPTs (Rapid Assessment and Psychosocial Treatment), or guidelines from established crisis services. This is a critical safety component.
